neighbours.label: the identifying slot of a sentence: ' what' in 'that's what I did', ' only' in 'the only way', ' primary' in 'one of the primary sources'; the output promotes ' factor', ' consideration', ' plays', ' influence'
fire: Every morning he ran two miles, because that's what his coach said.
For most people, the only way to learn is by doing.

In this town the only bank closes at noon.
Salt was one of the primary goods in that trade.
We were told to wait, so that's what we did.
Honestly, the only thing we need is more time.
quiet: His coach told him to run two miles every morning.

Tourists will bring some income to the area.

short: the identifying slot ('that's what', 'the only way')
notes: Card: ' what' x9, ' only' x8, ' the' x7, ' to' x2, ' good', ' primary'. Probe: ' primary' 0.300; ' what' after 'that's' 0.262; ' only' after 'the' 0.247; but 'This is what ... recommends' peaks elsewhere at 0.074 and ' good' 0.066. Near misses use the same subjects without the slot.
